Elbwerk Rollout moved initiative, then pursuing when the offer was released after the Wismar site visit, then delivering when the order came in.

The Abnahmeprotokoll is still open and overdue — it has to come back signed.

I closed the project, not the deal. I closed the project but left the deal as is: there is none on this record, and a project's phases are a different vocabulary from a deal's stages.
